meta.title: CloudMus — music player for Windows and Linux
meta.description: CloudMus is a cross-platform music player: Yandex Music, YouTube Music and a local folder, a shared queue, track downloads, media keys and a tray icon.

feat.01.d: Large covers, a window background that matches the current track, frosted-glass effect.
feat.02.d: Tracks from different sources in one queue.
feat.03.d: A list of played tracks across all sources.
feat.04.d: SMTC on Windows, MPRIS on Linux.
feat.08.d: Runs in the background, notifies about the current track.
feat.10.d: New versions install from within the app.
feat.12.d: A separate proxy for every service.
feat.13.d: The interface comes in several languages.
feat.15.d: The next track loads in advance and plays without a delay.
feat.16.d: Playback resumes from the same spot.
